subject: Science
question_text: What do plants need to make their food?
reference_answer: Plants need sunlight to make food. They also need water and carbon dioxide.

subject: Science
question_text: Why does an object make a shadow?
reference_answer: A shadow forms when an object blocks light. Light cannot pass through an opaque object.

subject: Science
reference_answer: Evaporation is when liquid water changes into water vapour. Heat makes it happen faster.

subject: Science
question_text: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
reference_answer: The heart pumps blood around the body.

subject: Science
question_text: Why does ice float on water?
reference_answer: Ice is less dense than liquid water. So it floats on top of the water.

subject: Science
reference_answer: A conductor is a material that lets electricity pass through it. Metals such as copper are good conductors.

subject: Science
question_text: Why should we wash our hands before eating?
reference_answer: Washing removes germs from the hands. This helps stop us from falling ill.

subject: Science
question_text: What causes day and night on Earth?
reference_answer: The Earth spins on its axis. The side facing the Sun has day and the other side has night.

subject: Science
question_text: What do the roots of a plant do?
reference_answer: Roots take in water and minerals from the soil. Roots also hold the plant firmly in the ground.

subject: Science
question_text: What happens when a magnet is brought near an iron nail?
reference_answer: A magnet attracts an iron nail. The nail moves towards the magnet.

subject: Science
question_text: Name the three states of matter.
reference_answer: The three states of matter are solid, liquid and gas.

subject: Science
question_text: What is the job of our teeth?
reference_answer: Teeth cut and grind food into small pieces. This makes the food easier to swallow and digest.
